blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) lack prognostic biomarkers, and computed tomography (CT)-based body composition radiomics at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) is a promising candidate. Small cohorts make high-dimensional radiomic models prone to overfitting and single-split evaluations variable and optimistic.
  This methodological study proposes a four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: (1) false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected feature selection, (2) a dual-path comparison of prior feature selection versus embedded regularization, (3) repeated nested cross-validation (CV) and (4) a negative control with Gaussian noise features. In 78 GEP-NET patients, 535 radiomic features from five L3 compartments were used to evaluate five survival models with Harrell's concordance index (C-index), time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) and integrated Brier score (IBS).
  Step 1 selected at least one feature in 18% of outer folds under noise (nominal level 20%) versus 84% with radiomic features. The dual-path comparison showed no consistent difference between strategies. Repeated nested CV reduced variability across seeds (41% median reduction in C-index standard deviation), but not enough to distinguish models. The nested CV C-index exceeded chance by 0.07-0.15 with radiomic features but not clearly under noise (0.40-0.42 with prior feature selection, 0.47-0.55 with embedded regularization). Frequently selected features tentatively linked greater subcutaneous fat, skeletal muscle compactness and texture to better prognosis.
  These findings suggest a modest prognostic signal in L3 radiomics, with considerable uncertainty that the protocol quantifies. The protocol may transfer to other small-cohort radiomic survival studies. Code: https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Workflow for radiomic feature extraction. A standardized volume consisting of ten central slices at the L3 vertebral level is selected from the abdominal CT scan. Automatic segmentations are refined by clinical experts to delineate four body composition compartments (skeletal muscle, subcutaneous fat, visceral fat, and intramuscular fat), alongside a fifth compartment, a spherical region of interest (ROI) placed manually in the paraspinal muscles (manual ROI). Finally, 107 radiomic features, encompassing shape, intensity and texture, are extracted from each of the five compartments per patient.
blocks.zh: 图1:放射特征提取工作流程。 从腹部CT扫描中选取由L3椎层的10个中心片组成的标准化卷. 临床专家对自动分块进行了精细分解,以划分出四个身体组成区块(骨骼肌肉、皮下脂肪、粘膜脂肪和肌肉内脂肪),与第五区块,一个球状感兴趣的区块(ROI)一起,人工放置于寄生虫肌肉(手动ROI). 最后,从每个病人的五个隔间中分别提取出107个放射特征,包括形状,强度和纹理.

blocks.en: Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) constitute a rare and biologically heterogeneous group of neoplasms arising from the neuroendocrine cells of the gastrointestinal tract and pancreas. These tumors are characterized by a markedly variable clinical behavior [ 13 ] : while most patients present with mild and non-specific symptoms following an indolent course over several years, others rapidly develop aggressive disease. Tumor grade, stage, and primary site are routinely used to stratify patients, yet outcomes remain markedly heterogeneous within each risk group [ 6 ] . Molecular markers could help refine risk stratification [ 40 ] , but their routine clinical availability is far more limited than that of conventional parameters. There is therefore a need for complementary, non-invasive biomarkers that can be derived from routine diagnostic imaging.
blocks.zh: 胃内分泌神经内分泌瘤(GEP-NET)由胃肠道和胰腺的神经内分泌细胞所生出的一种稀有和生物分泌的肿瘤组. 这些肿瘤的特点是临床行为明显可变[13]:虽然大多数患者在经过几年的无常过程后出现轻度和无特有症状,但其他患者则会迅速发展出攻击性疾病. 定期使用肿瘤分级、阶段和主站点对病人进行分级,但每个风险类别的结果仍然明显不同。 分子标记可以帮助细化风险分层[40],但其常规临床可用性远比常规参数有限. 因此,需要补充性、非侵入性的生物标记,这些标记可以从常规诊断成像中得出。

blocks.en: Body composition is a natural candidate. Sarcopenia, the progressive loss of muscle mass and strength [ 12 ] , has emerged as a potential predictor of mortality in patients with these tumors. However, it captures only one facet of the body composition alterations associated with malnutrition and cachexia, conditions that also affect adipose tissue and are known to worsen GEP-NET prognosis [ 41 ] . Assessing body composition as a whole therefore offers a broader perspective than muscle mass alone, which may be relevant for prognosis.
blocks.zh: 身体组成是自然的候选. Sarcopenia,即肌肉质量和强度的逐渐丧失[12],已作为这些肿瘤患者死亡的潜在预测器而出现. 然而,它只捕捉到与营养不良和缓存xia相关的身体组成变化的一个方面,这些条件也影响到脂肪组织,已知会恶化GEP-NET预后[41]. 因此,从整体上评估身体构成,比仅仅肌肉质量更能提供更广泛的视角,这可能与预测有关.

blocks.en:
Several methods exist for measuring body composition. Body mass index, although one of the most widely used nutritional indicators, cannot distinguish fat from lean tissue [ 5 ] , and is therefore insufficient to characterize these compartments.
In contrast, computed tomography (CT) analysis at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) has become the reference standard [ 41 ] : it accurately quantifies muscle and adipose tissue and relies on scans already acquired during routine oncological care [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh:
测量身体组成有几种方法。 体质指数虽然是使用最广泛的营养指标之一,但不能区分脂肪和瘦组织[5],因此不足以描述这些隔间.
相形之下,第三根腰椎(L3)的计算成的成像分析已成为参考标准[41]:它准确地将肌肉和脂肪组织量化,并依靠在常规肿瘤护理中已经获得的扫描[36]。

blocks.en:
Conventional L3 analysis, however, is limited to basic cross-sectional metrics. Radiomics offers a way to characterize tissues in much greater depth: by extracting high-dimensional parameters of tissue microarchitecture, it captures the intrinsic spatial heterogeneity of each compartment, providing a promising non-invasive strategy for biomarker development in oncology.
In neuroendocrine tumors, radiomics has been applied to therapy response [ 39 ] , histological grading [ 20 , 8 ] , and prognostic stratification of liver metastases [ 35 ] , but mostly through tumor-derived features. To the best of our knowledge, body composition radiomics remains largely unexplored as a source of prognostic biomarkers in these tumors.
blocks.zh:
然而,常规L3分析仅限于基本的跨部门测量。 放射素为更深入地描述组织特征提供了一种方法:通过提取组织微结构化的高维参数,可以捕捉到每个区块的内在空间异质性,为肿瘤学中的生物标记器发展提供了有希望的非侵入性策略.
在神经内分泌肿瘤中,放射素被应用于治疗反应[39],组织分级[20,8],以及肝元分泌[35]的预后分层,但大多通过肿瘤衍生特征. 据我们所知, 体内的放射性成分 基本上还没有被探索出来 作为这些肿瘤中预测生物标记的来源。

blocks.en: However, addressing this gap is methodologically demanding. GEP-NET are rare [ 13 ] , so available cohorts are inherently small. This is further aggravated in prognostic studies, which are typically framed as time-to-event (survival) analysis: the effective sample size is given by the number of events (deaths) rather than by the number of patients [ 38 ] . Radiomics, which yields hundreds of correlated features per patient, is especially vulnerable in this setting, since model validity and reproducibility are difficult to ensure when features far outnumber events [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,解决这一差距在方法上很需要。 GEP-NET是罕见的[13],所以现有的组群本来就很小. 在预测性研究中,这种情况更加恶化,这些研究通常被设定为时间对事件(生存)分析:有效的样本大小是由事件数量(死亡)而不是病人数量给出的[38]. 辐射每个病人产生数百种相关特征,在此情况下特别脆弱,因为当特征远远超过事件数量时,模型有效性和可复制性难以保证[25]。

blocks.en:
In practice, many studies select features without correction for multiple comparisons [ 7 ] , evaluate performance on a single train/test split [ 50 ] , and lack negative controls to verify that the identified signal is not an artifact of the analytical pipeline [ 52 , 4 ] . Together with the feature-to-event imbalance, these practices can produce optimistic or highly variable performance
estimates, making it difficult to distinguish genuine signal from noise [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh:
在实务中,许多研究在不更正的情况下选择特征进行多相比较[7],评价单列车/试跑分拆的性能[50],并缺乏负面控制来验证所识别出信号不是分析管道的文物[52,4]. 这些做法加上从特点到活动的不平衡,可以产生乐观或高度可变性的业绩
估计数,因此很难区分真信号和噪音。

blocks.en:
To mitigate these shortcomings, reporting and quality-assessment tools such as the Radiomics Quality Score [ 32 ] , CLEAR [ 31 ] , METRICS [ 30 ] and TRIPOD+AI [ 10 ] recommend, among other aspects, appropriate validation and transparent reporting.
However, they indicate what should be reported or assessed but do not provide a procedure to quantify how validation choices affect performance estimates. The protocol proposed here is intended as a quantitative complement to these guidelines. It combines four controls, each targeting a distinct methodological risk: feature selection with false discovery rate (FDR) correction for multiple comparisons, to limit false discoveries; a dual-path comparison (prior feature selection versus the full set of features with embedded regularization), to assess the sensitivity of the results to the dimensionality-reduction strategy; repeated nested cross-validation (CV), to counter optimistic and highly variable performance estimates; and a negative control, to detect artifacts of the analytical pipeline. As a clinical application, the protocol is used to evaluate the prognostic value of L3 body composition radiomics in GEP-NET across multiple survival models.
blocks.zh:
为了减轻这些缺陷,报告和质量评估工具,例如辐射质量分数[32]、CLEAR[31]、METRICS[30]和TRIPOD+AI[10],除其他外,建议适当的审定和透明的报告。
然而,它们表明应当报告或评估什么,但没有提供量化审定选择如何影响业绩估计的程序。 此处提议的议定书旨在从数量上补充这些指南。 它结合了四个控制,每个控制针对一个独特的方法风险:特征选择与虚假发现率(FDR)校正进行多重比较,以限制虚假发现;双向比较(前特征选择与嵌入式规范的全套特征对照),以评估结果对维度降低策略的敏感性;反复嵌入式交叉验证(CV),以抵消乐观和高度可变性的绩效估计;负面控制,以检测分析管道的文物. 作为一种临床应用,该协议用于评价GEP-NET中L3体成份放射素跨越多生模型的预测值.

blocks.en: 2 Materials and methods
blocks.zh: 2 材料和方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Recruitment and variable collection
blocks.zh: 2.1 征聘和可变收集

blocks.en:
This was a single-center, retrospective study conducted at Hospital Universitario de la Princesa (Madrid, Spain). Patients were drawn from a broader hepatopancreatobiliary oncology database and selected for this study if they met the following criteria: (i) a confirmed diagnosis of GEP-NET; (ii) clinical follow-up at the center; and (iii) availability of a baseline diagnostic CT scan.
Patients were excluded if they had a history of other gastrointestinal malignancies (including hepatocellular carcinoma), incomplete survival records, or imaging studies affected by significant motion artifact, absence of intravenous contrast or image misregistration. All data were pseudonymized prior to analysis.
blocks.zh:
这是在西班牙马德里的普林斯萨大学医院进行的一次单中心、回顾性研究。 患者取自更广泛的肝脏肿瘤数据库,如果符合以下标准,则被选入本研究:(一) GEP-NET得到确认的诊断;(二) 中心临床跟踪;(三) 是否有基线诊断CT扫描。
患者若有其他胃肠道恶性肿瘤(包括肝细胞癌)史,生存记录不全,或受重要运动文物所影响的成像研究,没有静脉对比或图像错误登记,则被排除在外. 所有数据在分析前都是假名。

blocks.en:
For each patient, the collected data included survival outcomes, demographic variables, and radiomic features.
Survival outcomes were defined by two parameters: event status (a binary indicator where 1 denotes death and 0 denotes a right-censored observation, representing patients who did not experience the event during follow-up), and overall survival time (measured in days from diagnosis to the date of death or last clinical contact) [ 9 ] .
Patient demographics, specifically age at diagnosis and sex, were used for descriptive and univariate survival analyses.
In contrast, the radiomic features were the only predictors included in the survival models. As shown in Figure 1 , the extraction process began with whole-body automatic segmentation using TotalSegmentator [ 51 ] , from which only the L3 region was retained. To ensure 3D homogeneity across the cohort, a standardized axial volume consisting of the ten central slices at the L3 level, corresponding to the minimum slice count available among all subjects, was selected. Automatic segmentations were subsequently reviewed and manually refined by three clinical experts [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
对于每个病人,所收集的数据包括生存结果、人口变量和放射特征。
生存结果由两个参数界定:事件状态(一个二进制指标,其中1表示死亡,而0表示右侧检查的观察,代表后续期间没有经历该事件的病人)和总体生存时间(从诊断到死亡或最后一次临床接触的天数衡量)[9].
病人人口统计,特别是诊断和性别年龄,被用于描述性和独生性生存分析。
相比之下,放射特征是生存模型中唯一包括的预测器. 如图1所示,取出过程开始于全身自动分解,使用TotalSegmentator [51],从中只保留了L3区域. 为确保各组的3D同位素,选择了一个由L3级的10个中心切片组成的标准化轴积,与所有科目中可用的最小切片数相对应。 随后,三位临床专家对自动分解进行了审查并进行了人工改进[14].

blocks.en: Within this final volume, five compartments were defined: four body composition compartments (skeletal muscle, subcutaneous fat, visceral fat, and intramuscular fat) [ 34 ] and a fifth compartment, a spherical region of interest placed manually in the paraspinal muscles (manual ROI). Using PyRadiomics [ 48 ] , 107 radiomic features were extracted from each of the five compartments, totaling 535 features per patient.
blocks.zh: 在这一最终体积中,确定了5个区间:4个体积组成区间(骨骼肌肉,皮下脂肪,粘膜脂肪,和肌肉内脂肪) [34] 第5个区间,这是手动放入寄生虫肌(人工ROI)中感兴趣的球形区域. 使用PyRadiomics [48],从5个隔间中分别提取出107个放射特征,每个患者共有535个特征.

blocks.en: 2.2 Proposed validation protocol
blocks.zh: 2.2 拟议审定议定书

blocks.en: The proposed validation protocol, illustrated in Figure 2 , comprises four steps: (1) FDR-corrected feature selection; (2) a dual-path comparison, in which five survival model configurations are fitted either on the selected set of features (Path A, prior feature selection) or on the full set of 535 features (Path B, embedded regularization); (3) repeated nested CV of both paths; and (4) a negative control on Gaussian noise features.
blocks.zh: 图2所示的拟议验证协议由四个步骤组成:(1)FDR修正的特征选择;(2)双路径比较,在所选特征(Path A,前作特征选择)上或者在全部535个特征(Path B,嵌入正则)上安装了5个生存模型配置;(3)两路径反复嵌入CV;(4)对高斯噪音特征进行负控制.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Proposed validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis. Step 1 selects features from the 535 radiomic features extracted across five compartments: a false discovery rate (FDR) filter (univariate Cox analysis with FDR correction, q ≤ 0.20 q\leq 0.20 ) followed by a redundancy filter (correlation clustering, | ρ | ≥ 0.80 |\rho|\geq 0.80 ). Step 2 establishes a dual-path comparison of dimensionality-reduction strategies: Path A fits the survival models on the selected set of features, whereas Path B fits them on the full set of 535 features, relying on embedded regularization. Step 3 evaluates both paths with repeated nested cross-validation (CV): 5-fold CV stratified by event status, with hyperparameters tuned in an inner loop, repeated with ten random seeds to quantify the variability of the estimates. Finally, Step4 applies the analytical pipeline (Steps 1–3) to Gaussian noise features as a negative control.
blocks.zh: 图2:放射性活性分析拟议验证规程. 第1步从从从5个隔间提取的535个放射特征中选择特征:一个假发现率(FDR)滤波器(有FDR校正的单变量克克斯分析,q 0.20 q\leq 0.20),然后是冗余滤波器(correction croming, ρ ρ 0.80 |\rho|\geq 0.80). 步骤2确定了减少维度战略的双向比较: 路径 A与所选一组特征上的生存模型相匹配,而Path B则与全部535个特征相匹配,依赖于嵌入式正则. 第3步用重复的嵌入式交叉验证(CV)来评价两条路径:5倍CV按事件状态分级,高参数以内环调取,再用10个随机种子来量化估计的可变性. 最后,Step4将分析管(Steps 1–3)应用于高斯噪声特征作为负控制.

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Feature selection
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 特色选择

blocks.en: Feature selection (Step 1) comprised two stages. In the first stage (FDR filter), a univariate Cox analysis based on the proportional hazards (PH) model [ 11 , 26 ] was performed for each feature, with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction [ 2 ] to account for multiple comparisons. A permissive threshold (FDR q ≤ 0.20 q\leq 0.20 ) was adopted [ 45 ] , as stricter thresholds selected too few features in the study cohort (0 at q ≤ 0.05 q\leq 0.05 ; 2 at q ≤ 0.10 q\leq 0.10 ). This threshold was used as an exploratory screening criterion rather than to establish statistical significance.
blocks.zh: 特色选择(步骤1)包括两个阶段。 在第一阶段(FDR filter)中,根据比例危险(PH)模型[11,26]对每个特性进行了统一活性Cox分析,由Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正[2]来进行多个比较. 采用了允许阈值(FDR q 0.20 q\leq 0.20)[45],作为更严格的阈值,选择了研究组太少的特征(0 q 0.05 q\leq 0.05;2 q 0.10 q\leq 0.10)。 这一阈值被用作探索性筛选标准,而不是确定统计意义。

blocks.en: In the second stage (redundancy filter) [ 3 ] , the features selected by the FDR filter were grouped by Spearman correlation-based hierarchical clustering (single linkage), so that features linked by | ρ | ≥ 0.80 |\rho|\geq 0.80 , directly or through other features, formed a single cluster. Within each cluster, a single representative feature was selected based on the highest Harrell’s concordance index ( C C -index) [ 21 ] obtained from the univariate Cox analysis [ 33 ] . The features that passed both stages formed the selected set of features used by Path A.
2.2.2 Dual-path comparison: survival models
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 双向比较:生存模式

blocks.en:
The second step compares the two paths to examine whether performance depends on the dimensionality-reduction strategy. Five survival model configurations were considered: Cox regression [ 11 ] with Ridge [ 23 ] or LASSO [ 46 ] penalization (Cox Ridge and Cox LASSO), random survival forest (RSF) [ 28 ] , gradient boosting survival analysis (GBSA) [ 17 , 27 ] , and survival support vector machine (SSVM) [ 47 , 42 ] . Each configuration was fitted independently on the selected set of features from Step 1 (Path A) and on the full set of features, relying on embedded regularization (Path B), yielding ten model–path combinations.
Hyperparameters of each configuration were tuned by grid search within the nested CV.
blocks.zh:
第二步比较了两条途径,以审查业绩是否取决于维度减少战略。 考虑了五个生存模式配置: Cox regress [11] 有Ridge [23] 或 LASSO [46] 处罚(Cox Ridge和 Cox LASSO),随机生存林 (RSF) [28],梯度增强生存分析 (GBSA) [17,27],以及生存支持向量机 (SSVM) [47,42]. 每个配置都独立地安装在步骤1(Path A)选定的一组特征上和完整的一组特征上,依靠嵌入式正则化(Path B),得出了十个模型-路径组合.
每个配置的超参数由网格搜索调取于嵌入式CV内.

blocks.en: Cox regression models were fitted with Ridge ( ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -norm) and LASSO ( ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -norm) penalization [ 43 ] . The grid for the penalty strength λ \lambda comprised ten log-spaced values in the range [ 10 − 1 , 10 2 ] [10^{-1},10^{2}] .
blocks.zh: Cox回归模型配有Ridge(l 2\ell\2}-Norm)和LASO(l 1\ell\1}-Norm)处罚[43]. 罚分强度的网格由10个在[10-1,10-2][10-+1],10-+x2]范围内的对数所组成。

blocks.en: Two tree-based ensemble algorithms were considered.
blocks.zh: 考虑了两个基于树的综艺算法.

blocks.en: The first, RSF, used a grid covering the number of trees ( { 500 , 1000 } \{500,1000\} ), the minimum number of samples required to split an internal node ( { 15 , 20 , 25 } \{15,20,25\} ), the minimum number of samples per terminal leaf ( { 15 , 20 , 25 , 30 } \{15,20,25,30\} ), and the number of features considered at each split.

The second, GBSA, was built on shallow decision trees; to control overfitting, its grid covered the learning rate ( η ∈ { 0.01 , 0.05 , 0.1 , 0.5 } \eta\in\{0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5\} ), the subsampling ratio ( { 0.5 , 0.7 , 1.0 } \{0.5,0.7,1.0\} ), and the maximum tree depth ( { 1 , 2 } \{1,2\} ).

A kernel-based SSVM was implemented in regression mode. The grid covered three kernel functions (linear, polynomial, and radial basis function), the penalty strength λ ∈ [ 10 − 4 , 10 2 ] \lambda\in[10^{-4},10^{2}] on a logarithmic scale, and, for the non-linear kernels, the kernel coefficient γ ∈ { 1 / p , 10 − 3 , 10 − 2 , 10 − 1 , 1 } \gamma\in\{1/p,10^{-3},10^{-2},10^{-1},1\} , where p p is the number of features.

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Evaluation

The final two steps of the proposed protocol address complementary questions: repeated nested CV provides a less variable performance estimate, whereas the negative control assesses whether the analytical pipeline yields above-chance performance in the absence of true signal.
blocks.zh: 拟议议定书的最后两个步骤涉及补充性问题:重复的嵌入式CV提供了较少可变的性能估计,而负控则评估分析管道在缺乏真实信号的情况下是否产生超强性能.

blocks.en: As the third step of the protocol, Steps 1 (feature selection) and 2 (dual-path comparison) were embedded within a 5-fold nested CV stratified by event status, repeated with ten random seeds (42–51). In turn, each outer fold was held out for evaluation (held-out fold), and the remaining four folds (outer-training data) were used exclusively for preprocessing, feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, and model fitting; all ten model–path combinations were then evaluated on the held-out fold. Hyperparameters were tuned by grid search in an inner loop on the outer-training data, selecting the value that maximized the C C -index. The inner loop used 5-fold CV for the Cox models, and Monte Carlo CV [ 53 ] with five random splits for SSVM, RSF, and GBSA, each split holding out 30 % 30\% of the outer-training data as validation data.
blocks.zh: 作为协议的第三步,步骤1(地貌选择)和2(双行道比较)被嵌入到5倍的巢状CV分层中,并被以10个随机种子(42-51)相重复. 反过来,每个外折被扣去评估(持有-退出折叠),剩下的四个折叠(外部训练数据)则专门用于预处理、特征选择、超参数调制和模型安装;然后所有10个模型-路径组合都用于持有-退出折叠。 超参数在外部训练数据的内环中通过网格搜索来调取,选择C -index的最大值. 内环对Cox模型使用5倍CV,而Monte Carlo CV[53]对SSVM,RSF,和GBSA则使用5个随机分出,每个分出将30%的30\%分出外部训练数据作为验证数据.

blocks.en:
Performance was evaluated with two discrimination metrics, the C C -index and the time-dependent area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) [ 22 ] , for which higher values indicate better performance, and with the integrated Brier score (IBS) [ 18 ] . Unlike the C C -index and AUC, the IBS measures overall prediction error, combining discrimination and calibration, so lower values indicate better performance; it is not defined for SSVM. The reference value is 0.25 0.25 , obtained by a model that assigns a 50 % 50\% survival probability to every patient at every time point [ 18 , 44 ] .
If Step 1 selected no features in the outer-training data of a given outer fold, the corresponding evaluation was assigned chance-level discrimination ( C C -index and AUC of 0.5 0.5 ), with the IBS treated as undefined. For each seed, performance was summarized as the mean across the five outer folds, and results are reported as the mean ± \pm standard deviation (SD) between seeds.
blocks.zh:
对性能进行了两个区分度量评价,C指数和接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下的时间依赖区[22],其中较高的数值表明性能较好,综合Brier分数(IBS)[18]. 与C-index和AUC不同,IBS测量总体预测出错,结合了区分和校正,因此较低的值表示性能更好;它没有为SSVM定义. 参考值为0.250.25,通过一个模型获得,该模型在每个时间点[18,44]给每个病人分配了50%-50-Q的存活概率.
如果第1步在给定外折叠的外接训练数据中没有选择任何特征,则相应的评价被指定为机会级歧视(C-index和AUC为0.5 0.5),IBS则被视为未定义. 对于每个种子,性能被总结为横跨五个外缘的平均值,结果被报告为种子之间的平均值±\pm标准差(SD).

blocks.en: Path A and Path B were compared on the same outer folds of the nested CV. For each seed, the paired difference between paths was computed fold by fold and averaged across the outer folds. The comparison was summarized with two measures: Δ A − B \Delta_{A-B} , the mean paired difference across seeds, and n A n_{A} , the number of seeds in which Path A performed better.

blocks.en: As the fourth and final step, the analytical pipeline (Steps 1–3) was applied after replacing the radiomic features with Gaussian noise features of the same dimensions, keeping the survival outcomes unchanged.
blocks.zh: 作为第四个也是最后一个步骤,分析管道(Steps 1-3)在用同样维度的高斯噪音特征取代放射特征后被应用,使生存结果保持不变.

blocks.en: 2.3 Validation scheme for performance estimates
blocks.zh: 2.3 业绩估计审定办法

blocks.en: To examine how the choice of validation scheme affects performance estimates, the same analytical pipeline was applied under two schemes: (i) a single 70/30 train/test split stratified by event status (single split), with 70 % 70\% of the study cohort as training data and 30 % 30\% as test data, and (ii) the repeated nested CV of Step 3. For each of the ten seeds, both schemes were applied to the same cohort, and all other steps were identical and fitted exclusively on the training data (the outer-training data in the nested CV): z z -score standardization, feature selection, and hyperparameter tuning in an inner loop [ 15 , 49 ] .

For the IBS, the sign of Δ \Delta was inverted so that, for all metrics, positive values indicate a more favorable estimate under the single split.

blocks.en: 2.4 Univariate survival analysis
blocks.zh: 2.4 异变活性分析

blocks.en: In addition to the protocol, a descriptive univariate survival analysis was performed after the analytical pipeline. This analysis was not used for feature selection or model evaluation. Demographic variables (age and sex) were analyzed in the study cohort, and the radiomic features selected in Step 1 were analyzed in the training data of the single split.
blocks.zh: 除议定书外,在分析程序完成之后,还进行了描述性无静脉性活性分析。 这一分析没有用于特征选择或模型评价。 研究组对人口变量(年龄和性别)进行了分析,第1步选择的放射特征在单一分数的培训数据中进行了分析。

blocks.en: For each variable, a univariate Cox analysis was performed to estimate the hazard ratio (HR, expressed per SD for continuous variables), its 95% confidence interval (CI), and the C C -index. For the radiomic features, statistical significance was assessed with the Wald test, with the Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction for multiple comparisons applied to the 535 features, as in Step 1. For the demographic variables, which were treated as categorical (age was grouped as < < 55, 55–65, 65–75, and ≥ \geq 75 years), significance was assessed by comparing Kaplan–Meier (KM) survival curves with the log-rank test. The PH assumption was tested with scaled Schoenfeld residuals [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 对每个变量都进行了无偏差Cox分析,以估计危险比率(连续变量每SD表示HR),其95%的置信间隔(CI)和C-指数。 对于放射特征,通过Wald测试评估了统计意义,对535个特征进行了多次比较的Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正,如步骤1。 对于被视为绝对的人口变量(年龄被归类为 < 55、55-65、65-75和\geq 75年),通过将Kaplan-Meier(KM)存活曲线与对数排名测试进行比较,评估了重要性。 PH假设被用缩放的Schoenfeld残基测试 [19].

blocks.en: To evaluate the consistency of selection, Step 1 was repeated on the training data of 100 random 70/30 splits stratified by event status. The selection frequency (SF) of each feature was defined as the proportion of repetitions in which it was selected, and the conditional selection frequency (CSF) as the same proportion restricted to repetitions in which at least one feature was selected. Features with lower SF and CSF were interpreted with greater caution. This analysis was exploratory and did not alter the selected set of features.
blocks.zh: 为了评价选择的一致性,在100个随机70/30分数按事件状况分级的训练数据上重复了第1步。 每个特性的选取频率(SF)被定义为被选取的重复次数的比例,有条件的选取频率(CSF)被定义为被选取至少一个特性的重复次数的相同比例. 具有较低的SF和CSF特征的特征被更谨慎地解释. 这种分析是探索性的,没有改变选定的一套特征。

blocks.en: The initial cohort comprised 113 patients. After applying the exclusion criteria, 78 patients ( 69 % 69\% ) were retained for the final analysis (Table 1 ). The study cohort was balanced by sex ( 48.7 % 48.7\% female, 51.3 % 51.3\% male), with a median age at diagnosis of 63 years and a median observed overall survival time of 2,523 days (events and censored patients combined). During follow-up, 27 patients ( 34.6 % 34.6\% ) died, while the remaining were censored (Table 1 ). For subsequent survival analysis, age at diagnosis was grouped into four groups of similar size ( < < 55, 55–65, 65–75, ≥ \geq 75 years).

blocks.en: KM analysis (Figure 3(a) ) showed a gradual decline in survival over the first 3,000 days, with survival probability remaining above 70 % 70\% . Beyond this point the curve flattened, with wide confidence intervals reflecting the small number of patients still at risk.

Four of the seven features showed a protective effect (HR < < 1): Contrast and Sphericity in skeletal muscle, alongside GLNU and Major Axis Length in subcutaneous fat. Conversely, the remaining three features were associated with increased risk (HR > > 1): Idmn in intramuscular fat, and Contrast and Correlation in subcutaneous fat (Figure 4(a) ). Regarding the selection stability assessment, only two features were selected in at least half of the repetitions (SF ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ): GLNU from subcutaneous fat and Sphericity from skeletal muscle. When considering the CSF, Contrast from skeletal muscle also exceeded this threshold. These statistics are strictly descriptive, as they were derived from an initial feature selection.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Biological relevance of selected features
blocks.zh: 4.1 选定特征的生物相关性

blocks.en:
Three features were selected considerably more often than the rest (CSF ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ), all of them associated with lower risk: GLNU in subcutaneous fat, and Sphericity and Contrast in skeletal muscle (Table 2 ). In the latter compartment, the protective effect of Sphericity may reflect a more compact shape, whereas that of Contrast, which captures the spatial rate of intensity change, may reflect a better-preserved texture.
In subcutaneous fat, GLNU tends to increase with the number of size zones and hence with the amount of tissue, which suggests that a greater subcutaneous tissue extent may relate to a better prognosis.
Contrast in subcutaneous fat, which was selected less often than the three features above (CSF of 0.35 0.35 ), was associated with higher risk. This may indicate that a greater spatial variation of intensity in this compartment reflects a heterogeneity linked to adverse outcome, unlike in skeletal muscle. The meaning of this feature may therefore differ between compartments. Given its lower selection frequency, however, this association is less reliable and chance cannot be excluded.
Major Axis Length in subcutaneous fat was selected with a similar frequency, but it violated the PH assumption (Schoenfeld p = 0.021 p=0.021 ), so its hazard ratio was not interpreted. The remaining two features, Correlation in subcutaneous fat and Idmn in intramuscular fat, were selected too rarely to be interpreted (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
选取的三个特征比其他特征(CSF 0.5\geq 0.5)要多得多,它们都与较低风险有关:皮下脂肪中的GLNU和骨骼肌肉中的球状和相抗性(表2)。 在后一区间中,Sphericity的保护作用可能反映更紧凑的外形,而Contrast的捕捉强度变化的空间速率则可能反映保存较好的纹理.
在皮下脂肪中,GLNU往往会随着体积区数的增加而增加,从而会随着组织量的增加而增加,这表明皮下组织范围较大可能与更好的预后有关.
皮下脂肪的对比性比上述三个特征(0.35 0.35 的CSF)要少,因此风险较高。 这可能表明,这个区间强度的空间差异较大,反映了与不良结果相关的异质性,这与骨骼肌肉不同. 因此,这个特征的含义可能因区间不同而不同. 但是,由于选择的频率较低,这种联系的可靠性较低,不能排除机会。
皮下脂肪中的主要轴长被选取出相近的频率,但违反了PH假设(Schoenfeld p = 0.021 p = 0.021),因此其危险比没有被解释. 其余两个特征,即皮下脂肪的关联性和肌肉内脂肪的Idmn,被选入太少,无法解释(表2)。

blocks.en: Taken together, the features selected most often point to subcutaneous tissue extent, muscle compactness and muscle texture as tentative correlates of a more favorable prognosis. These findings are exploratory, however, given the modest FDR-adjusted p p -values of the selected features (Table 2 ) and their heterogeneous selection frequencies, and should be regarded as hypothesis-generating.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,所选择的特征往往表明,皮下组织范围、肌肉紧凑和肌肉纹理是更有利的预后的初步关联。 然而,这些结论是探索性的,因为选定特性(表2)的FDR调整后p-值不大,而且其选择频率各不相同,因此应被视为假设产生。

blocks.en: 4.2 Feature selection and validation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 特性选择和验证协议

blocks.en: The difference between the single-split and nested CV estimates showed no systematic direction, but it was not negligible: the mean absolute difference between schemes ( | Δ | |\Delta| ) was 0.07 0.07 for the C C -index (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 单片CV和相窝CV估计的差别没有表现出系统性的方向,但并非可忽略不计:各方案(QQ QQ Delta|)之间的平均绝对差别为C-index(表3)0.07.

blocks.en: The SD between seeds of the single-split estimates was comparable to the range of the model means under nested CV for the three metrics (Table 3 ). A model comparison based on a single split can therefore reflect the split drawn rather than genuine differences between models. Repeated nested CV reduced this variability (median SD reduction of 41 % 41\% , 28 % 28\% , and 60 % 60\% for the C C -index, AUC, and IBS, respectively) but did not eliminate it: the remaining SD between seeds ( 0.02 0.02 – 0.06 0.06 for the C C -index, Table 3 ) was still of the same order as the differences between models, in line with the fact that no model could be clearly distinguished from the others.
blocks.zh: 单片估计种子之间的自毁率与三个度量的嵌入式CV下的模型手段范围相当(表3)。 因此,基于单一拆分的模型比较可以反映模型之间抽取的拆分而不是真正的差异. 被反复嵌入的CV降低了这种可变性(C-index,AUC,和IBS分别中SD降低41%为41\%,28%为28\%,60%为60\%),但没有消除:C-index,C-index,表3的种子之间的剩余SD(0.02 0.02 – 0.06 0.06)与模型之间的差异仍然相同,这与没有模型可以与其他模型明确区分的事实是一致的.

blocks.en: The dual-path comparison served as a sensitivity analysis of the dimensionality-reduction strategy. With the radiomic features, the mean nested CV C C -index exceeded chance level by 0.07 0.07 – 0.15 0.15 across models and paths, a modest signal of similar magnitude in both paths. Neither path was consistently better: differences between them were small relative to their dispersion and their direction varied between models. We therefore found no evidence that performance depended on the dimensionality-reduction strategy, and prior feature selection offered no consistent predictive benefit.
blocks.zh: 双向比较是对维度减少战略的敏感性分析。 有了放射特征,平均筑巢的CV C-index超过了机会水平0.070.07 – 0.15 0.15 跨模型和路径,这是两条路径相近的适度信号. 这两种途径都好不到哪里去:它们之间的差别与其分散性相比很小,它们的方向因模式而异。 因此,我们没有发现任何证据表明业绩取决于维度-减少战略,先前的特征选择没有提供一致的预测效益。

blocks.en: The negative control showed that, in neither path, performance with Gaussian noise features clearly exceeded chance level. Estimates stayed close to 0.5 0.5 in Path B ( C C -index 0.47 0.47 – 0.55 0.55 , within one SD between seeds in every model) and fell below it in Path A ( C C -index 0.40 0.40 – 0.42 0.42 ). The margin of the radiomic features over noise was therefore small in Path B ( C C -index 0.03 0.03 – 0.13 0.13 , AUC 0.04 0.04 – 0.13 0.13 across models) and larger in Path A ( C C -index 0.21 0.21 – 0.25 0.25 , AUC 0.22 0.22 – 0.27 0.27 ), reflecting noise estimates below 0.5 0.5 (Figure 6 ). These estimates are available only for the nine outer folds with a non-empty selection and are consistent with the selection of features that do not generalize, so the larger margin should not be interpreted as an advantage of Path A.
blocks.zh: 负面控制显示,在两个路径中,与高斯噪音特征的性能都明显地超过了机会水平. 估计数字在路径B(C-index 0.47-0.55-0.55,在每个模型种子之间的一个自毁内)保持在接近0.5;在路径A(C-index 0.40-0.40-0.42)下方。 因此,在Path B(C-index 0.03 0.03 – 0.13 0.13;AUC 0.04 – 0.13 0.13 不同型号)中,辐射特征相对于噪声的比值很小,在Path A(C-index 0.21 – 0.25 0.25 ;AUC 0.22 0.22 – 0.27 0.27)中,其噪声估计值低于0.5 (图6). 这些估计只能用于非空取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取

blocks.en: The negative control also showed that, with Gaussian noise features, Step 1 selected at least one feature in only 18 % 18\% of the outer folds, in line with the upper bound of q = 0.20 q=0.20 expected for the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure under a global null hypothesis. With the radiomic features, this proportion was 66 66 percentage points higher, which suggests that, in this cohort, at least some features are associated with survival in the training data, beyond what would be expected by chance after FDR correction. The cost of Step 1 was modest: the 16 % 16\% of outer folds without selected features lowered the nested CV C C -index and AUC of Path A by 0.02 0.02 – 0.03 0.03 . Taken together, the above-chance performance with the radiomic features, its absence under noise and the marked difference in the selection rate point to a modest prognostic signal in this cohort, although its magnitude remains uncertain.
blocks.zh: 负控还显示,由于高斯噪音特征,步骤一在外折面中只选择了18%-18-%的至少一个特征,与全球无效假设下本杰明尼-霍克伯格程序预期的q=0.20q=0.20的上限一致. 从放射特征来看,这一比例高出66.66个百分点,这表明,在这一群体中,至少有一些特征与培训数据中的生存有关,超出了在FDR校正后偶然预期的水平。 步骤一的成本是微薄的:没有选定特性的外折叠率为16%的16-%将嵌入式CV C-index和路径A的AUC降低了0.02 0.02 – 0.03 0.03. 综上所述,具有放射特征的上述表现、噪音下的缺失和选择率的明显差异,都表明这一组人的预测信号不大,尽管其规模仍然不确定。

blocks.en: Finally, the metrics captured different aspects of performance [ 24 ] . With the radiomic features, the IBS showed a pattern that was not mirrored by the discrimination metrics: for Cox Ridge and RSF, the C C -index and AUC were on average higher in Path B, whereas the IBS favored Path A (lower IBS) in eight of ten seeds for Cox Ridge and in all ten for RSF, although the mean difference exceeded its SD between seeds only for RSF. Given the small magnitude of these differences, we regard this as a tentative signal rather than as evidence of the superiority of Path A.
blocks.zh: 最后,衡量尺度反映了业绩的不同方面[24]。 具有放射特征的IBS显示出一种没有歧视指标反映的模式:对Cox Ridge和RSF来说,C-index和AUC在B道平均较高,而IBS则在Cox Ridge的10个种子中的8个种子和在所有10个种子中偏好A道(低于IBS),尽管平均差异超过了只对RSF的种子之间的自毁. 鉴于这些差异的规模很小,我们认为这是一个暂时的信号,而不是证明路径A具有优越性。

blocks.en: 4.3 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 4.3 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Some limitations should be acknowledged when interpreting these findings.
blocks.zh: 在解释这些结论时,应承认一些局限性。

blocks.en: First, patient recruitment was restricted to a single center using a uniform imaging protocol. While this homogeneity helps reduce technical confounding, it also limits the generalizability of our results. Although the repeated nested CV reduces the dependence of the estimates on a single split, it cannot fully replace external validation, the gold standard for assessing generalizability [ 29 ] . Such external validation was not performed in this study, as, to the best of our knowledge, there is no publicly available dataset combining CT-based L3 body composition with GEP-NET survival outcomes.
blocks.zh: 首先,患者的招募被限制在一个单一的中心,使用统一的成像协议. 虽然这种同质性有助于减少技术混乱,但也限制了我们结果的通俗性。 虽然被反复嵌入的CV会减少估计对一分法的依赖,但它不能完全取代外部验证,即评估通性性的金本位 [29]. 这项研究没有进行这种外部验证,因为据我们所知,没有将基于CT的L3体组成与GEP-NET生存结果相结合的公开数据集。

blocks.en: Second, because the results derive from a single, relatively small cohort, the model-specific differences between Path A and Path B should not be extrapolated to other datasets. The main contribution of this study is a protocol that quantifies how the validation scheme and the dimensionality-reduction strategy affect the performance estimates, using a negative control as reference. This is particularly relevant in small cohorts.
blocks.zh: 第二,由于结果来自单个相对较少的组群,因此不应将路径A和路径B之间的模型特异性推断出其他数据集. 这项研究的主要贡献是一项协议,它用负控制作为参考,量化验证计划和维度降低策略如何影响性能估计. 这在小群体中尤其重要。

blocks.en: Third, the radiomic analysis was based on features extracted from a single baseline CT scan. Incorporating features from follow-up imaging as time-varying covariates could capture longitudinal changes in body composition, potentially improving predictive performance beyond what a single baseline assessment can offer [ 1 ] . However, relying on baseline data can be viewed as more clinically relevant, given that it better reflects the real-world decision-making environment prior to the manifestation of the outcome.
blocks.zh: 第三,放射分析是根据从单一基线CT扫描中提取的特征进行的。 将后续成像中的特性作为时间变化的共变物,可以捕捉身体构成的纵向变化,有可能提高预测性能,超出单一基线评估所能提供的范围[1]。 然而,可以认为依靠基线数据在临床上更具有相关性,因为它更好地反映了结果表现之前的现实世界决策环境.

blocks.en: Fourth, the negative control of Path A rests on only nine outer folds (six seeds), so estimates below chance should not be over-interpreted. In addition, assigning chance-level discrimination ( C C -index and AUC of 0.5 0.5 ) to the folds with an empty selection is a convention of the protocol that shifts the mean estimates of Path A towards 0.5 0.5 (lowering them by 0.02 0.02 – 0.03 0.03 for the radiomic features), and other conventions could yield different values.
blocks.zh: 第四,路径A的负控制只依靠9个外折(6个种子),因此机会下的估计不应被过度解释. 此外,将机会级歧视(C-index和AUC为0.5 0.5)划入空选的折叠是议定书的一项公约,它将路径A的平均估计值改为0.5(辐射特征降低0.02-0.03-0.03),其他公约可以产生不同的价值。

blocks.en: Finally, Step 1 selected no features from the manual ROI. This should not be taken as evidence that manual segmentation is less informative than automated whole-muscle segmentation, since the ROI was small, covered a different region, and its shape features may mainly reflect the placement of the segmentation sphere. Given the low statistical power in this compartment, this observation is at most hypothesis-generating.
blocks.zh: 最后,步骤一从手动ROI中选择了没有的特性. 这不应被视作人工分解比自动整核分解信息少的证据,因为ROI是小的,覆盖了不同的区域,其形状特征可能主要反映分化球体的位置. 鉴于这个区块的统计力很低,这种观察最多只能产生假说.

blocks.en:
Building upon these limitations, several natural extensions emerge for future research. Clinically, the skeletal muscle index (SMI; muscle area normalized by height squared) could be derived from the existing L3 segmentations. This would allow relating the radiomic features to low muscle mass, a CT-based proxy of sarcopenia, and determine whether they offer prognostic value beyond this conventional metric.
Methodologically, the comparisons rely on descriptive differences across ten seeds rather than on formal testing, since all seeds resample the same cohort and standard paired tests assume independence. Tests corrected for dependent resampling, such as the Nadeau and Bengio corrected t t -test [ 37 ] , are a natural extension. A complementary negative control based on permuting the survival outcomes, which preserves the correlation structure of the radiomic features, would also help to confirm the behavior of both paths under the null.
blocks.zh:
在这些限制的基础上,出现了若干自然延伸,供今后研究。 在临床上,骨骼肌指数(SMI;由高平方正方形使肌肉区域正常化)可以从现有的L3分出. 这将使放射特征与以CT为基础的低肌肉质量(sarcopenia)联系起来,并确定它们是否提供超出这一常规度量的预测值。
从方法上讲,比较依靠10个种子的描述性差异,而不是正式的测试,因为所有种子都重现同一组和标准的对等测试具有独立性。 对所依赖的再取样进行校正的测试,如Nadeau和Bengio校正 t -t测试[37],是一种自然延伸. 基于活性结果的互补负控制,保留了放射特征的相通性结构,也将有助于确认空下两种路径的行为.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This study proposed a four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts, in which each step targets a distinct methodological risk: Step 1, FDR-corrected feature selection (false discoveries); Step 2, a dual-path comparison (sensitivity to the dimensionality-reduction strategy); Step 3, repeated nested CV (optimistic or highly variable performance estimates); and Step 4, a negative control on Gaussian noise features (artifacts of the analytical pipeline). The protocol was applied to 78 GEP-NET patients, using 535 CT-based radiomic features extracted from five compartments at the L3 level, to evaluate their prognostic value across five survival models.
blocks.zh: 这项研究提出了对小群体放射性活性分析的四步验证协议,其中每一步都针对一种独特的方法风险:步骤1,FDR修正的特征选择(假发现);步骤2,双路径比较(对维度-降低战略的敏感性);步骤3,重复嵌入CV(乐观或高度可变性的性能估计);和步骤4,对高斯噪音特征的负控制(分析管道的艺术特征)。 该协议被应用于78名GEP-NET患者,使用从L3级5个隔间取出535个CT基放射特征,以评价他们在5个生存模型中的预测值.

blocks.en: In this cohort, each step of the protocol provided useful information for interpreting the performance estimates. Step 1 behaved as designed: it selected at least one feature in only 18 % 18\% of the outer folds with Gaussian noise features, consistent with its nominal level ( q ≤ 0.20 q\leq 0.20 ), versus 84 % 84\% with the radiomic features. The dual-path comparison, a sensitivity analysis of the dimensionality-reduction strategy, showed that neither path was consistently better, so the estimates were largely insensitive to this choice. Compared with a single split, repeated nested CV did not shift the estimates in a consistent direction, but it reduced their variability between seeds (median reduction in SD of 41 % 41\% for the C C -index, 28 % 28\% for the AUC and 60 % 60\% for the IBS), although the remaining variability was of the same order as the differences between models. Finally, the negative control showed that, whereas the mean nested CV C C -index with the radiomic features exceeded chance level by 0.07 0.07 – 0.15 0.15 across models and paths, performance with Gaussian noise features did not clearly exceed it ( C C -index 0.40 0.40 – 0.42 0.42 in Path A, over nine folds, and 0.47 0.47 – 0.55 0.55 in Path B), so the pipeline itself is unlikely to generate apparent performance from noise.
blocks.zh: 在这一组中,协议的每个步骤都为解释业绩估计提供了有用的信息。 第1步表现得和设计一样:它在只有18%的有高斯噪声特征的外折叠中至少选择了1个特征,与其名义水平一致(q 0.20 q\leq 0.20),而有放射特征的外折叠中则选择了84%的84. 双行道比较是对维度-减少战略的敏感性分析,它表明,这两种途径都并非始终比较好,因此,估计数基本上对这项选择不敏感。 相较于一分一分,被反复嵌入的CV并没有将估计值向一致的方向转移,而是降低了种子之间的可变性(C-index的自毁率下降为41%,AUC的下降为28%,而IBS的下降为60%,尽管剩下的可变性与模型之间的差异顺序相同. 最后,负控显示,虽然有放射特征的嵌入式CV C - C - 指数比机会水平高出0.07 0.07 — 0.15 – 跨模型和路径,高斯噪声特征的性能并没有明显超过它(C-index 0.40 0.40 — 0.42 – Path A中的0.42 0,有9个折叠;0.47 0.47 — 0.55 0.55),因此管道本身不太可能从噪声中产生出明显的性能.

blocks.en: Reporting several summary measures was also worthwhile [ 24 , 16 ] , as discrimination and overall prediction error did not always agree: for RSF and Cox Ridge, the IBS was lower in Path A, whereas the C C -index and AUC were on average higher in Path B.
blocks.zh: 报告若干总结措施也是值得的[24,16],因为歧视和总体预测错误并不总是一致的:对无国界医生组织和Cox Ridge来说,IBS在路径A中较低,而C-index和AUC在路径B中平均较高。

blocks.en: Regarding the prognostic analysis, age at diagnosis was associated with overall survival in this cohort. Among the radiomic features, those selected most often pointed, tentatively, to a greater subcutaneous fat extent, a more compact skeletal muscle and preserved muscle texture as correlates of a more favorable prognosis. Given the sample size and the heterogeneous selection frequencies, these interpretations should be regarded as hypothesis-generating.
blocks.zh: 关于预测性分析,诊断年龄与这一群体的总体生存有关。 在放射特征中,被选中者往往会暂时将骨骼更紧凑的肌肉和保持的肌肉纹理指向更有利的预后。 鉴于样本规模和不同的选择频率,这些解释应被视为产生假设。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results suggest that L3 body composition radiomics may carry a modest prognostic signal in this GEP-NET cohort, although the uncertainty quantified by the protocol precludes firm conclusions about any specific model. The protocol is not specific to this application and may be applicable to other radiomic survival studies in small cohorts, where high dimensionality and a limited number of events pose similar methodological risks. Its transferability, however, remains to be tested.
blocks.zh: 总之,这些结果表明,L3体状放射物可能在这个GEP-NET组群中带有微小的预测信号,尽管议定书量化的不确定性排除了对任何具体模型的确定结论. 协议并非具体针对这一应用,可能适用于小群体中的其他放射性活性研究,在这些群体中,高维度和有限的事件构成类似的方法上的风险. 然而,其可转让性仍有待检验。
